baseline_models.focus_anchor: تستترون ... يشهد عليكم سمعكم ولا أبصاركم ولا جلودكم sets attempted concealment against the subject's own bodily witnesses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The bodily envelope is double-use: hearing receives, sight observes, and skin covers the actor, yet these same sites can issue knowledgeable evidence against the possessive self.

activation_trace.role: Literal hiding and covering supply the privacy action that the verse denies as protection from testimony.
A knowledgeable declaration makes the body's testimony evidentiary disclosure rather than mere presence.
Auditory reception supplies an evidence-bearing channel located inside the actor's own sensorium.
The body's outer sheath supplies the apparent boundary of privacy and then becomes one of its witnesses.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely failed to hide deeds from eventual witnesses.
changed_reading.after: Their own boundary and receptors form an internal archive: the apparatus used to inhabit private action is already capable of disclosing it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ولكن ظننتم أن الله لا يعلم كثيرا مما تعملون explicitly joins supposition about divine knowledge to a large field of deeds.
baseline_models.mechanism: A low-certainty estimate about limited divine awareness becomes practical permission for numerous intentional acts; an epistemic error organizes conduct.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain conjecture supplies the weak epistemic basis on which the actors nevertheless rely.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the awareness whose scope their conjecture falsely restricts.
Numerical abundance makes the supposed blind zone broad rather than exceptional.
Deliberate action turns the faulty estimate into an operating rule for conduct.

changed_reading.before: They held an abstractly mistaken belief that God did not know some deeds.
changed_reading.after: They converted weak conjecture about the scope of divine awareness into behavioral permission for many deliberate acts; the failure is practical epistemology.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سمعكم وأبصاركم وجلودكم are grammatically possessed by the accused yet stand against them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The acting self is distributed across perceptive and working members; those members bear signs that can make the self legible against its preferred account.

activation_trace.role: A condition-mark that bears witness makes bodily evidence readable as a sign of what occurred.
Inner discernment and self-witnessing turn sight from a passive organ into a mode of self-knowledge.
The working limb binds intentional deeds to the bodily members that execute and retain their trace.

changed_reading.before: The organs function as external witnesses unexpectedly attached to the accused.
changed_reading.after: The testimony is distributed self-evidence: the self's own perceptive and operative members contradict the unitary story it tells about itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah constructs a deliberate anti-reception system around heart, ear, and interpersonal space, then shows the supposedly disabled sensorium testifying. Concealment is therefore not only hiding deeds but managing what can enter, register, and count as knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Entry into a protective interior supplies a claimed heart-level enclosure that extends the focus's hiding inward.
Literal weight in the ear turns hearing from an open receiver into a deliberately burdened channel.
An obstructing screen formalizes separation between message and hearer as part of the concealment architecture.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the available perceptual route against which blindness is chosen.
Intentional choosing supplies agency to blindness, making sensory failure a preference rather than a mere deficit.
Refusal of understanding and compliance makes non-listening an organized stance toward the recitation.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the masking technique used to prevent meaningful reception.
Coercive victory supplies the intended payoff of sensory masking, exposing it as strategy.

structural_cues: 41:5 stacks heart-coverings, ear-weight, and a between-space barrier before the reciprocal challenge to work.
41:17 calls blindness preferred over guidance; 41:26 coordinates non-listening and noise as a bid to prevail; 41:44 repeats ear-weight and blindness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered barriers, chosen blindness, and coordinated masking noise; I infer that these are practical forms of تستترون whose reversal is organ testimony. A live alternative is that the passages diagnose rejection of revelation without specifying how the later organs retained evidence.

changed_reading.before: Their bodies simply defeat an attempt to hide private misconduct.
changed_reading.after: The witnessing body reverses a cultivated anti-reception system: faculties they burdened, blinded, and masked still register enough to disclose the conduct that system enabled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heaven and earth first answer divine address; immediately before the focus the organs testify, and the skins explain that the creator made every thing speak. Bodily evidence belongs to a creation-to-return arc of responsive matter.

activation_trace.role: Created heaven and earth's willing compliance supplies an earlier model of matter answering divine address.
The prior scene supplies the actual knowledgeable declaration that the focus retrospectively explains.
The bodily sheath becomes a speaking respondent, joining material boundary to accountable voice.
Articulate speech supplies the explicit enabling event and generalizes it from skins to every thing.
Creative origination grounds bodily speech in the same agency that constituted the speakers.
Return restores the created body to the forum where its latent responsiveness becomes testimony.

structural_cues: 41:11 gives heaven and earth a spoken obedient answer; 41:20 enacts testimony; 41:21 gives skins an answer and attributes speech to every thing.
41:21 closes with creation, first occurrence, and return, placing bodily speech inside a full temporal arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel scenes of created entities answering and an explicit creator-enabled speech claim; I infer a shared mechanism of created responsiveness. The materially live alternative is a one-time forensic miracle rather than a standing capacity of matter.

changed_reading.before: The organs are unexpectedly animated at judgment to furnish evidence.
changed_reading.after: Their testimony culminates a surah-wide responsiveness of creation: the body was never inert property under the actor's exclusive control and answers its creator upon return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's conjecture is named as the cause of ruin, then situated amid attached companions who beautify the accessible temporal field until liability becomes fixed. The false estimate is sustained by a social-perceptual environment.

activation_trace.role: Repeated weak conjecture identifies the focus's estimate itself as the immediately named causal object.
A fall into destruction supplies the consequence assigned directly to that conjecture.
An attached companion supplies the social carrier that can stabilize a shared field of judgment.
Making something appear good supplies the perceptual editing by which the visible field becomes persuasive.
Fixed and deserved liability supplies the endpoint at which curated conjecture hardens into consequence.

structural_cues: 41:23 makes ذلكم ظنكم the subject of أرداكم, giving the conjecture explicit causal force.
41:25 places paired companions, beautification of what is before and behind, and fixed judgment in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct ruin by conjecture and a later companion-beautification sequence; I infer that social curation helps sustain the focus's false estimate. The alternative is that the beautification concerns deeds and temporal expectations broadly, not this specific belief about divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The actors independently make a mistaken estimate about what God knows.
changed_reading.after: Their estimate is an actionable, socially scaffolded enclosure: companions beautify the available field until weak conjecture feels inhabitable and its resulting liability becomes fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah mirrors the focus's human faculties with divine hearing and knowing, then denies hiddenness, predicates discerning sight of deeds, and closes with total cognitive enclosure. Organ testimony publicizes evidence but does not fill a gap in divine awareness.

activation_trace.role: Hearing predicated of God supplies a divine-side receptive term that mirrors the focus's human hearing without equating them.
Full disclosure to the knower directly opposes the focus's conjecture of limited awareness.
Hiddenness and covering are explicitly negated at the divine vantage, collapsing the proposed blind zone.
Deliberate work is first licensed rhetorically and then made the direct object of discerning observation.
Penetrating discernment supplies sight as comprehensive awareness of deeds rather than limited ocular capture.
Complete cognitive enclosure supplies the terminal spatial model in which no deed can sit outside awareness.

structural_cues: 41:36 pairs السميع with العليم; 41:40 pairs لا يخفون علينا with بما تعملون بصير.
41:54 closes the surah by placing every thing within divine encompassing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored faculty terms, explicit non-hiddenness, discernment of deeds, and encompassing; I infer that bodily witnesses manifest knowledge rather than produce it. The alternative is that their primary function is public forensic proof despite prior divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The organs provide information that exposes deeds otherwise left unobserved.
changed_reading.after: No evidentiary gap ever existed: embodied testimony makes already encompassed knowledge public and self-involving, so concealment fails at the level of ontology before it fails in court.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later deeds accrue for or against the self, while signs shown within selves disclose truth under universal witness. The focus's عليهم can therefore be read as action returning through embodied self-evidence, not merely alien accusation.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the deed whose effect is syntactically returned to its doer.
The very self or identity supplies the beneficiary and bearer of its own action.
Signs located in their own selves make the body an internal evidentiary field.
Emergence into clarity supplies the disclosure process by which inward signs become decisive.
Reality matching what is the case supplies the truth disclosed by signs within the self.
Universal knowledgeable witness situates embodied self-disclosure inside a complete evidentiary frame.

structural_cues: 41:46 balances عمل صالح فلنفسه against أساء فعليها, returning action to the self.
41:53 moves from signs in horizons and selves to disclosure of truth and universal witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action returning to the self and signs disclosed within selves; I infer that organ testimony is one concrete mode of this self-return. The alternative is that أنفسهم denotes human interiority generally and is not specifically linked to the named organs.

changed_reading.before: Body parts side with an external prosecution against their owner.
changed_reading.after: The body is where action returns to and becomes legible within the self; testimony against them is the self's own enacted structure disclosing truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a lexicalized, branch-distant hearing-looking pattern rather than the ordinary sense of سمع. It remains anchored by the focus's exact progression from hearing and sights to supposition and work. Downstream prose should present it only as a diagnostic analogy for epistemic habit, not as the lexical meaning of سمعكم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سمعكم ولا أبصاركم ... ولكن ظننتم ... مما تعملون places hearing, seeing, conjecture, and action in one focus sequence.

activation_trace.role: A hearing-looking pattern that fails to see clearly and then acts by conjecture unexpectedly binds the focus's sensory terms to its epistemic error.
Ordinary ocular inspection supplies the perceptual check that the activated pattern fails to complete.
Weak conjecture supplies the substitute conclusion adopted when sensory apprehension does not mature into knowledge.
Intentional action supplies the behavioral endpoint of the failed sensory-to-knowledge sequence.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and sight only record deeds and later report them.
changed_reading.after: The same faculties may also expose a pre-deed habit: sampling sound and sight without attaining insight, then allowing supposition to govern action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy from fruit sheaths and gestation to skin and concealed deeds. It remains anchored in تستترون, جلودكم, and لا يعلم, while 41:47 explicitly surrounds emergence from coverings and hidden bearing with knowledge. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory mechanism, not claim that the ayah lexically identifies skin with a plant sheath or pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins covering, bodily skin, supposedly limited knowledge, and deeds held within embodied life.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the attempted static occlusion whose material behavior the later emergence sequence revises.
The body's outer sheath supplies the focus-side container from which evidence can be imagined as emerging.
Awareness supplies the disputed relation between a hidden interior and the knower.
Knowledge explicitly encloses both outward emergence and inward bearing, defeating opacity at either stage.
Bringing something out of hiddenness supplies the directional transition from containment to disclosure.
A plant's enclosing vessel supplies the material analogue for a cover that contains rather than erases what is inside.
Hidden inward bearing supplies a second containment process already fully within knowledge.
Release by birth supplies the second outward transition, reinforcing disclosure from an enclosed interior.

changed_reading.before: Skin and concealment form a static screen intended to keep deeds unseen.
changed_reading.after: Embodied cover can be imagined as a containing sheath: it preserves what is within until hidden content emerges as evidence, all while already enclosed by knowledge.

strongest_changes: Failed hiding becomes the reversal of a surah-wide program of sensory insulation: covered hearts, weighted ears, chosen blindness, and organized noise.
Organ testimony belongs to a creation-wide pattern of answering and creator-enabled speech rather than an arbitrary late animation.
Divine hearing and knowing, discerning sight of deeds, and total encompassing remove any evidentiary gap; bodily testimony is self-involving disclosure within prior complete knowledge.
The destructive conjecture is not merely private error but can be carried by companions and a beautified perceptual field.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus a hinge between anti-reception and disclosure: the same senses that were strategically disabled become witnesses, while the unusual sensory-guesswork branch and the later sheath-emergence sequence preserved two contained readings a conservative synthesis could miss.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction ما كنتم تستترون أن يشهد can foreground inability to hide from the organs or denial that fear of their testimony motivated concealment; both support failed privacy but distribute agency differently.
The link from companion-driven beautification in 41:25 to the specific conjecture about divine knowledge is abductive; the packet also permits a broader link to deeds and temporal expectations.
The sheath and gestation model is materially coherent but cross-domain and should remain exploratory.
